summary: Verified Module 03 conceptual and operational requirements: route separation, HTTP 400 validation semantics, and expired link lifecycle management.
evidence: Student explained route isolation between /r/{code} and system routes (/health, /docs, /links) to prevent collisions and namespace pollution.
Student justified HTTP 400 Bad Request for client-side input validation failures.
Student identified that expired links must never redirect and should return HTTP 410 Gone / 404 with a descriptive message.
